name: NGEx Minerals Ltd.
summary: NGEx Minerals Ltd., founded in 2019 and headquartered in Vancouver, acquires, explores and advances mineral assets in South America. Its flagship is the Los Helados porphyry copper-gold-silver project in Chile's Atacama Region. It also holds interests in Argentina, including the Valle Ancho and Interceptor properties in Catamarca and the Potro Cliffs project in San Juan.
